subject: maths
question: Choose the correct statement from the following.

options.text: HCF is the least common multiple of the given numbers.
HCF of two or more numbers is the highest number which perfectly divides all the given numbers.
HCF is also called the least common divisor.
In prime factorisation method of HCF, the multiples of all the given numbers are listed.

solution:
Concept used:

HCF of two or more numbers is the greatest factor that divides the numbers.

Calculation:

HCF of two or more numbers is the highest number that perfectly divides all the given numbers.

**∴ Option 2 is the correct answer.**
